LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.0.label: Reforged Bloodmail
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.0.descrip: Retains Bloodforged Armor, its original growth and awakening without granting lifesteal, health or defense twice. Later nodes use ordinary hits and actual healing from this tree; empty healing grants no rewards.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.1.label: Living Plates
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.1.descrip: While you have recoverable injuries, every 3 effective ordinary hits heal 40 base injury points on yourself, once per 8 seconds. Hits during cooldown or without injuries do not count. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 40.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.2.label: Donor Strike
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.2.descrip: Every 3 effective ordinary hits heal 40 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. With no injured ally, retain one completed charge for a later ordinary hit; extra charges cannot be stored. Base rewards: healing 40.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.3.label: Sealed Plates
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.3.descrip: After Living Plates actually heals an injury, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Original lifesteal and healing from other sources cannot trigger it. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.4.label: Restored Retaliation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.4.descrip: After Living Plates actually heals an injury, store one retaliation opportunity for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on an enemy consumes it for 75 bonus damage. The hit that creates it cannot spend it; at most one is stored. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.5.label: Donor Shelter
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.5.descrip: After Donor Strike actually heals an ally, gain a separate 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Only this tree’s actual injury healing counts; healing a healthy target grants nothing. Base rewards: shield 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.6.label: Bloodveil Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Bloodmail.nodes.6.descrip: After Donor Strike actually heals an ally, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight of you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The shield selects its recipient independently of the heal. Base rewards: shield 50.
